status: Independent pre-code candidate design. Exact ten-slot cohort requested by parent; baseline feasibility and parent freeze remain separate. No future renderer output used.
coordinateOrder: fraction of actual inherited H above y0
normalRule: Apply inverse transpose diag(1/s,1/H,1/s) and normalize, or derive world triangle normals. Stored normal belongs to x/h/z coordinates.
triangulationRule: Explicit independently prescribed planar partitions. Concave footprints use ear clipping, never hull/fan fill.
decorationRule: D only declared upward ground paving or water at .004H. Housing127 has no D. All walls/roofs are W/O.

sourceReferences.grounding: British tram-depot and municipal workshop context; D080 plans are original abstractions.

components.groundClosure: complete footprint boundary at y0; ground supplies the base interface

models.uniquenessDesignRationale: A continuous eight-sided Z footprint has two opposed re-entrant corners and a complete raked roof. No previous L, T, V, U or rectangular workshop shares its footprint topology.

models.name: Y-plan tram waiting pavilion

components.groundClosure: complete footprint boundary at y0; ground supplies the base interface

models.uniquenessDesignRationale: Three outward arms and three real intervening notches meet one enclosed central hall. A radial roof covers the entire Y footprint without filling the exterior notches.

components.groundClosure: complete footprint boundary at y0; ground supplies the base interface
complete footprint boundary at y0; ground supplies the base interface

models.uniquenessDesignRationale: A true concave rear court cuts into a five-sided apex-roof sorting house; a lower complete rectangular intake attaches to the opposite front. Not a convex radial hall with a roof-only change.

models.name: Cranked council housing slab

components.groundClosure: complete footprint boundary at y0; ground supplies the base interface

models.uniquenessDesignRationale: Four perimeter walls define a genuinely concave cranked slab with a deep open notch. Its flat roof uses two concavity-preserving triangles. Not a sheared or scaled rectangular slab.

models.name: Kite-plan council point block

components.groundClosure: complete footprint boundary at y0; ground supplies the base interface

models.uniquenessDesignRationale: A skew kite footprint supports a descending diagonal ridge between opposite corners, with two roof planes and four complete raked wall faces. Unlike the prior kite marine hall there are no interior ridge vertices or detached ticket house.

models.name: Diagonal-valley council housing

components.groundClosure: complete footprint boundary at y0; ground supplies the base interface

models.uniquenessDesignRationale: A skew non-parallelogram slab has a genuine descending diagonal roof valley between low opposite corners. It changes both footprint and signed roof concavity relative to the kite ridge block, and differs from the rectangular six-boundary-vertex butterfly nursery. No rotation or axis scaling can change a convex ridge into this concave valley.

models.name: Re-entrant fishery keeper lodge

components.groundClosure: complete footprint boundary at y0; ground supplies the base interface

models.uniquenessDesignRationale: Five perimeter walls and a real re-entrant lake-facing cutout distinguish this compact keeper lodge from prior convex five-sided day pavilions. Two ground-only ponds remain separate from structure.

models.name: Paired fishery keeper rooms

components.groundClosure: complete footprint boundary at y0; ground supplies the base interface
complete footprint boundary at y0; ground supplies the base interface

models.uniquenessDesignRationale: Two detached scalene triangular rooms have complete monopitch roofs, unequal heights and an open service gap. No previous two-house composition uses two triangular enclosed footprints.

models.name: Chamfered folded fishery store

components.groundClosure: complete footprint boundary at y0; ground supplies the base interface

models.uniquenessDesignRationale: A canted five-sided keeper store has three explicit noncoplanar roof facets ending in a high canted point. No central apex, rotated rectangular box or filled concave notch.

models.name: Remembrance hall and vigil pavilion

components.groundClosure: complete footprint boundary at y0; ground supplies the base interface
complete footprint boundary at y0; ground supplies the base interface

models.uniquenessDesignRationale: A broad fully enclosed triangular remembrance hall has three complete roof facets. A second lower enclosed triangular vigil pavilion is detached across a positive ground gap. This is neither a recolored monument shaft nor a box with a hip, and it differs from the fishery pair by component roof topology and massing.
